expanded_title: Ran Deep at The Shuffle 214: $100K Guaranteed Hand Highlights and a Min-Cash Story
expanded_deck: Had the table talking deep in Shuffle 214's $100K Guaranteed series — including an all-in clash with Ace-King against King-Jack — before settling for a min-cash and a story worth more than the payout.
expanded_body:
Originally posted March 17, 2026.

Ran deep at The Shuffle 214 in the $100K Guaranteed series and had the table talking… until the poker gods had other plans.

In one of the key all-in pots from the session (captured in the hand-highlights reel on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/reel/2045881562627473/), my Ace of Clubs and King of Hearts went to war preflop against an opponent's King of Clubs and Jack of Hearts with a big stack of tournament chips in the middle.

That's tournament poker. Min-cash secured, but the story was worth way more than the payout. Back at it soon.

— Sham
author: Shomari Williams
